title: Comparison of Final Round Accuracy Across All Methods
rationale: The user requested a comparison of accuracy for all methods at the last round. A bar chart is selected to clearly compare categorical method performance on a single metric value. The data is filtered to the last observation based on the 'round' column.
assumptions: Selected 'last' row selection mode ordered by 'round' to isolate the final experimental round for each method series.
Wide-format table melted into long-format using series_columns as categories and 'value' as the metric.
No aggregation or error bars applied as there are no repeated seeds/observations per method in the selected row.
